integrity: The analytical matrix-convex proof establishes the infinite family; finite spectral enumeration is supplementary. Novelty is relative to inspected literature and indexed findings, and independent audit is not performed.
limitations: The upper squared coefficient-energy bound is optimized for exactly three anchors on unweighted cycles and host Parseval frames; no theorem is claimed for condition number, lower bound, weighted cycles or larger sample sets. Asymptotics are for N tending to infinity.
title: Optimal three-anchor harmonic Fourier analysis on a finite cycle
